headline: Interim & Fractional CLO | Workforce Capability & Transformation Advisor | I build the capability that makes AI adoption stick

sections.bio:
Digital transformation does not become sustainable simply because an organisation deploys technology. It succeeds when people, leaders, and routines turn new tools, policies, and strategies into reliable day-to-day performance.

I work as an Interim and Fractional Chief Learning Officer and Workforce Capability & transformation advisor. I build workforce capability, manager ownership and learning systems that turn AI, digital and organisational change into everyday performance.

My work is especially relevant to complex, regulated and knowledge-intensive organisations—particularly in financial services, insurance, energy, the public sector and professional bodies. I also support adjacent organisations facing similar transformation and capability challenges.

A core part of my work is designing AI-assisted competency and capability frameworks. These evidence-based systems move beyond “trained/not trained” records, showing who can perform critical work, who needs support, and who can coach or assess others.

I co-created the Pilot-to-System Gap (PSG-4) Framework through collaborative research with the Urban Twin Transition Center (UTTC) and the Swedish Center for Digital Innovation (SCDI). PSG-4 explains why promising digital and AI initiatives stall after the pilot stage: symbolic adoption, middle-management disconnect, uneven diffusion and the absence of an institutional anchor.

I help leaders move from isolated pilots into embedded organisational practice by:

Defining role-specific capabilities for high-risk, regulated and operationally critical work
Identifying credible evidence of competence, readiness and capability gaps
Aligning learning, performance, compliance and operational leaders around a shared capability model
Equipping middle managers to reinforce new ways of working
Building learning systems, governance and routines for sustained AI adoption

Typical engagements include:
Interim/Fractional CLO leadership
Workforce capability and competency architecture
AI workforce and transformation-readiness diagnostics
Learning-strategy renewal and learning-ecosystem design
Manager enablement for AI, digital and organisational change
AI-supported skills, evidence and capability systems

Based in Sweden, I work remotely and through hybrid engagements with organisations in Nigeria, across Africa, the Nordics and other English-speaking markets.

If you are leading AI adoption, growth, transformation or technological change—and want workforce capability to become a strategic advantage—let’s connect.
